title: Citation
description: A citation extracted from a document or section. Represents a reference from one legal entity to another.

citation_id.description: Unique identifier for the citation. Format: cit_{ulid}

source_document_id.description: ID of the document containing the citation.

source_section_id.description: ID of the section containing the citation, if applicable.

target_document_id.description: ID of the referenced document, if resolved.

citation_text.description: The raw citation text as it appears in the source.

normalized_reference.description: Normalized form of the citation reference.

citation_type.description: Type of citation (e.g., statute_reference, case_reference, regulation_reference).

resolved.description: Whether the citation has been resolved to a target document.
